summary: Registered SYN.A market maker (ETF-MM) quoting a SELL of 5322 (its typical size) and a BUY of 1064 together, re-priced about every 3s with the touch. The only executions were on its own SELL quotes (17504). There was no BUY execution, so no opposite-side benefit. No single order reached 3x depth, and no event or risk cut was involved. The detector's 'SELL execution' triggers are fills on the resting sell side, not opposite-side trades. Closure standard met: feature (b) is absent and feature (a) is explained by market making.

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A quoting 321 on both sides (typical size 327, about 0.13x depth) and re-pricing them every 1-10s. The BUY executions (92 and 44) were fills on its own resting bid. There was no opposite-side execution, so there was no benefit. No large order, no repetition of a spoof cycle. The detector's 'BUY execution then SELL cancel' is the two-sided quote refresh. Closing as a false positive.

Agency trader's large BUY ICEBERG (21768, 8.97x depth, parent C-T-X1005-05-A) was working: 5835 (26.8%) executed before the only opposite-side trade, a 544 SELL under a different parent (C-T-X1005-05-B, a separate client order). The remainder of 15933 was cancelled 2s after that SELL. The order was working, so feature (a) is absent. The SELL was a different client's order, smaller than the prior same-side fills, with no reversion, so feature (b) is absent. Genuine execution of the resting order is supported.

Registered market maker T-MM-01 on SYN.A quoted both sides at a constant 391 per order and re-quoted about every 1-10 s. Every order is far below the depth, and cancels are symmetric across sides. The only fills were on the trader's own BUY quotes, and there was no opposite-side execution. The detector's 'BUY execution of 58' was a partial fill of the trader's own resting bid O-00008763. The cancel of the 391 SELL was the paired re-quote. Both core features are absent and market making is supported.

PROP trader placed one BUY LIMIT of 38461 (15.7x depth) 2 ticks off the touch with nothing on the other side. 2.5s later they sold 1423 by market order, and the BUY was cancelled in full 360 ms after that. The BUY had no fills. Price moved 0.5 tick in the trader's favour and reverted 1.0 tick after the cancel. No market event, risk event, MM registration or parent order explains it. This is one cycle, so I propose escalation, not a STOR draft.

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A quoted both sides at 366 (desk typical 327; max 0.149x depth), re-pricing every 1-8 s. Cancels are symmetric (0.98). The only executions were on its own BUY quotes (441), with no opposite-side execution, so there is no benefit. The detector's 3.25x depth trigger counted gross two-sided quote turnover. No single order reached 3x depth. Closed as market making.

Registered market maker T-MM-01 on SYN.A quoted a symmetric two-sided 391 bid/ask and re-quoted every 1-7 seconds. The detector counted the 8602 gross BUY size as large against depth. No single order is large: the maximum resting size is 0.16 x depth. The two SELL partial fills (126 and 118) were on the trader's own ask quotes. The price did not move in the trader's favour and did not revert. Neither core feature is present.

Prop trader (no MM registration) placed one BUY LIMIT of 27,326 (11.15x depth), 2 ticks from the touch. About 2.2s later a SELL market order of 640 executed while it rested. The BUY then took 4,707 of fills, all after the sell, and the remaining 22,619 was cancelled 704 ms after the sell. Price moved +1 tick in the trader's favour and reverted 1.5 ticks after the cancel. No supported legitimate explanation. The pattern is one-sided and matches the escalation standard's 'caught in the book' test. It is a single cycle, so I propose ESCALATE rather than DRAFT_STOR.

A single PROP BUY of 18930 (7.9x depth) at 9997, 1 tick below the bid, was cancelled after 803 ms with no fills on either side. 401 ms later the same trader re-entered a BUY of 1893 at the same price, which is exactly one tenth of the size. This looks like a size entry error that was corrected. There was no opposite-side execution and no price benefit, so feature (b) is absent. Feature (a) is not supported, because the pattern fits a fat finger. Proposed CLOSE_FP at moderate confidence. Level 2 should confirm the 10x size with the desk if there is doubt.

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A quoted both sides every 1-3s with identical 356-lot orders at the touch (bid 9998/9999, ask 10002/10003), re-pricing continuously. The detector fired because the SELL quote was hit (14 then 342) and the paired BUY quote was cancelled in the same re-quote. No single order approaches 3x depth (max 0.149x), cancel symmetry is 0.98, price moved -0.5 ticks (not in the trader's favour) with no reversion. Both core features are absent and market making is supported.

ALGO-EXEC trader quoted two-sided with PEGGED child orders of parents P-T-X1012-02-B and P-T-X1012-02-S, each 2424 (the desk's typical size, about 1.04x depth), at the touch. Cancels are symmetric across sides (0.996) and follow the touch. There is no large single order, no favourable move with reversion, and no one-sided resting order. The high OTR is explained by re-pricing. Closure standard met via algorithmic re-pricing.

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A refreshing symmetric two-sided 356-lot quotes about every 1-6 s. The detector fired on gross submitted volume (about 14.6k per side over the window) against 2385 depth. No single order is large (max 0.149x depth), cancels are symmetric across sides (0.99), and fills were on the quotes themselves. The price moved against the trader (-1 tick) with no reversion. The round trip is ordinary spread income. No public event or risk event. Closure standard met.

Prop trader placed five BUY limit orders of 4340 each (21700 total, 8.7x top-5 depth) on consecutive price levels 9988-9992 within about 60 ms. About 2 s later the trader sold 799 by market order at 9995/9993 after the bid had risen from 9993 to 9995. All five BUY orders were cancelled 0.3-0.9 s after the sell, with zero fills on the buy side. The pattern is one-sided and has no market-making, algo, risk, event or genuine-execution explanation. Both core features are present. It is a single cycle with a modest benefit, so I propose ESCALATE to Level 2 rather than a STOR draft. Level 2 drafts any STOR.

PROP trader placed one SELL limit of 21443 (8.17x avg top-5 depth) 2 ticks from the touch, with nothing resting on the other side. 2.4s later the trader bought 1189 by market order, and the SELL was cancelled in full 363 ms after that. The SELL had no fills and no modifies. No legitimate explanation is supported: the trader is not a registered MM, there is no news, no risk event and no parent order. Feature (a) is present. Feature (b) is not clearly shown: price move and reversion are 0 and the buy swept the ask from 9998 to 9999 on its own. The cycle repeats 3 times in the session. Evidence is mixed with no supported explanation, so escalate to Level 2. This is not a STOR draft at Level 1 because no clear benefit is shown.

Registered market maker on SYN.A re-quoting a symmetric two-sided pair of 3302 (its typical size, 1.26x depth) every 2-3 seconds. Cancels are symmetric (0.97) and follow the quote re-pricing. There is no single large order, no favourable price move before the fills (-0.5 ticks) and no reversion. Both core features are absent; the detector triggered on the quote refresh cadence.

ALGO-EXEC algo quoting both sides with PEGGED child orders of two parents (P-...-B and P-...-S). Every order is 1984, the desk's typical size and 0.76x depth. Orders sit at the touch and are cancelled and re-pegged in lockstep on both sides (cancel_symmetry 0.996). No single order reaches 3x depth. The opposite-side fills are small and show no favourable move with reversion. The detector fired on gross submitted size from the constant re-pegging. Algorithmic re-pricing is supported and both core features are absent.

Prop trader rested two identical BUY 7215 orders at 9996 (combined 5.5x depth, 1.5 ticks from touch), never executed. While they rested, a SELL 515 filled at 10001 after the bid had risen. Both BUYs were cancelled together 142 ms after an unscheduled issuer news item. The news fits the cancel timing, but the sale came before the news, price moved 1.5 ticks in the trader's favour, and it reverted 2 ticks after the cancel. The evidence is mixed, so I am escalating rather than closing.

Registered market maker T-MM-01 on SYN.A re-quoting a symmetric 395-lot bid/ask pair every 1-6 seconds. The detector's 'gross SELL 8690' is the sum of these quotes, and its 'BUY execution of 46' is a partial fill on the trader's own resting bid. There is no large order (max 0.15x depth), no opposite-side (SELL) execution, no price-move benefit and no market-wide cancel cluster. Both core features are absent and market making is supported.

Single BUY O-00013143 (11565, 4.64x depth, 1 tick behind the touch) was working: 2774 (24%) executed in two partial fills before the trader's only opposite-side trade (SELL 346 at 11:40:25). That is eight times the opposite quantity. The later 7866 reduction and the 12 filled afterwards are ordinary order management of a working order. No favourable-move benefit is attributable, because the same-side fills make price_move uninformative. There is no event, no repetition and no prior alert.

One BUY LIMIT of 23620 (9.48x depth) was placed 1 tick behind the touch and cancelled after 966 ms. The trader made no opposite-side trade and had no fills. 1.2 s ... 0.4 s after the cancel, the same trader placed a BUY of 2362 at the same price, exactly one tenth of the size. This looks like a one-off decimal entry error that was corrected. Feature (b) is absent: no opposite-side execution, no price benefit. Feature (a) is not supported: the order is better explained by fat finger.

Prop trader (not a registered MM) placed five one-sided SELL limits of 4,734 each (23,670 total, 9.4x avg top-5 depth) over 4 price levels (10006-10009) in about 60 ms. About 1.1 s later the trader bought 624 by market order at 10004-10005. All five sells were cancelled within roughly 0.2-1.0 s of the buy, with zero fills on the sell side. The touch moved 1 tick in the trader's favour and reverted 1.5 ticks after the cancels. No event, risk cut, parent order or MM registration explains it. Both core features are present. This is one cycle in the session with a modest benefit, so I propose escalation to Level 2 rather than a STOR draft.

One large BUY (O-00017411, 19570, 7.96x depth, 1 tick behind the touch) was working: 3568 (18.2%) executed in two partial fills before the trader's only opposite-side trade (SELL 587), which is smaller than the same-side fills. The remainder was reduced by MODIFY after that. Under section 6.2 this is genuine execution of the resting order, so feature (a) is absent. The small SELL is ordinary order management, not feature (b). No reversion was observed, there are no repetitions and no prior alerts. Closing as FP, with moderate confidence because the order was large and the price rose 2 ticks.

PROP trader (no MM registration) placed three one-sided BUY limits of 4514 each (13542 total, 5.4x depth) at 9997-9998, 6 ticks from the touch, over 13:50:46-50. At 13:51:04.003 they sold 700 by market order (954 less 554 cancelled remainder of 1254). All three bids were cancelled together 600 ms later with zero fills. Feature (a) looks present: one-sided, away from touch, never executed, 100% cancelled. Feature (b) is not shown: price moved against the seller (-1.5 ticks), no reversion, round trip -4.77 ticks. A stop-out of an earlier 1254 buy is a possible explanation but does not account for the layered bids, so the evidence is mixed. Escalate to Level 2; this is not a STOR draft (no repetition, no benefit).

Registered market maker T-MM-02 on SYN.A quoted both sides at 335 per order (desk typical 327), re-quoting every 1-6s. Cancels are symmetric across sides (0.99). No single order approached 3x depth (max 0.13x). No favourable price move (0.0 ticks) and no reversion. The detector fired on gross quote churn. The fills were on the quotes themselves. Both core features are absent and market making is supported.

AGENCY trader T-X1028-06 had one ICEBERG BUY (O-00023657, 17528, 7.2x depth) at the touch (9994). It was executing: 2990 (17%) filled over 13:47:47-13:47:55, all before the only opposite-side trade, a 438 SELL under a different parent order (C-T-X1028-06-B) at 13:48:02. The price did not move in the trader's favour and did not revert. The remainder (14538) was cancelled 2s later. This is genuine execution of a working hidden-size order. Feature (a) is absent and feature (b) is absent. Proposed close as a false positive.

Single one-sided SELL LIMIT of 20314 (8.35x depth, 2 ticks from touch) was placed with no parent order and no fills. 1.8s later the trader bought 1130 by market order, and the SELL was fully cancelled 127ms after that. Price moved 0.5 tick in the trader's favour and reverted 1.5 ticks after the cancel. No legitimate explanation is supported, so L2 should review. The earlier pegged-algo closures do not hold on today's tape. This is not DRAFT_STOR because there is one cycle only and the benefit is small.

Trader T-X1028-09 placed one SELL LIMIT of 31,395 (12.9x avg top-5 depth) at 10006, 3 ticks from the touch, with nothing resting on the buy side. 2.8s later the trader bought 1,053 by market order at 10002-10003. The SELL was cancelled in full 158 ms after that. It had no fills. The price reverted 2.5 ticks after the cancel. No legitimate explanation is supported. This is a single cycle, so I propose ESCALATE to Level 2, not DRAFT_STOR.

The detector fired on 2677-lot SELL orders being cancelled after BUY fills. The tape shows a PEGGED two-sided algo. Parent orders P-T-X1029-06-B and P-T-X1029-06-S each re-peg an identical 2677-lot child to the touch every 2-4 s. Cancels are symmetric (0.97). No order exceeds 1.05x depth, and all orders sit at the touch. 6657 lots executed on the BUY side before the only opposite-side fill of 1118. The price moved against the trader (-3.5 ticks) with no reversion. There was no benefit (feature b) and the orders were working (feature a absent).

Three BUY limits of 5152 (15456 total, about 6.1x depth for the resting side) were placed 5s apart at 10002/10002/10000. The trader then sold 772 at 10006, and all three BUYs were cancelled in the same millisecond, 13:35:37.550. The profile records an automated kill switch at exactly that time ('intraday loss limit breached; automated kill switch cancelled all resting orders'). The sell did not benefit from price movement: price_move_ticks 0.0, reversion_ticks 0.0, post-cancel move -0.5. The cancel is explained by the risk event and feature (b) is absent. Residual doubt: the BUYs were large, one-sided and unfilled, and the kill switch came 1s after the sell fill.
